```{r global}
source("R/load_packages.R")
load_packages()

source("R/colors.R")
source("R/teams.R")
source("R/plot_theme.R")

data_raw <- read.csv("data/weekly_fantasy_points.csv")
dat_s <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(Fantasy.Points = if_else(Projection==0.0 & Fantasy.Points==0.0, NA, Fantasy.Points))
```

Sidebar {.sidebar}
=====================================
```{r sidebar}
CURRENT_WEEK <- 11
all_weeks <- unique(dat_s$Week)
past_weeks <- all_weeks[all_weeks < CURRENT_WEEK]
future_weeks <- all_weeks[all_weeks >= CURRENT_WEEK]

renderText({
  paste("Current Week:", CURRENT_WEEK)
})
br()

pickerInput(
    inputId = "week", 
    label = "Week", 
    choices = list("Past weeks" = past_weeks, "Future weeks" = future_weeks),
    selected=past_weeks, 
    multiple = TRUE, 
    options = pickerOptions(
        actionsBox = TRUE, 
        size = 10, 
        selectedTextFormat = "count > 3", 
        countSelectedText = "{0} weeks selected"
    )
)

pickerInput(
    inputId = "position", 
    label = "Position", 
    choices=c(unique(dat_s$Position)), 
    selected="QB", 
    multiple=TRUE,
    options = pickerOptions(actionsBox = TRUE, size = 10)
)

pickerInput(
    inputId = "team", 
    label = "Team", 
    choices=nfl_teams_by_division,
    selected=c(unique(dat_s$Team)), 
    multiple = TRUE, 
    options = pickerOptions(
        actionsBox = TRUE, 
        size = 10, 
        selectedTextFormat = "count > 3", 
        countSelectedText = "{0} teams selected"
    )
)

pickerInput(
    inputId = "point_type",
    label = "Point Type", 
    choices = list(
        "Fantasy Points" = c("Total Points", "Mean Points"),
        "Projected Points" = c("Total Projected Points", "Mean Projected Points")
    ),
    options = pickerOptions(container = "body"), 
    selected = "Total Points",
)

numericInput(
    inputId = "n_players", 
    label = "Number of Players to show", 
    value = 20, 
    min = 1, 
    max = 40
)

selected_weeks <- reactive({
  str_extract_all(input$week, "\\d+")
})

n_players_selected <- reactive({
  if(is.na(input$n_players)){
      return(1)
  }
  if(input$n_players > 40){
      showNotification("The number of players must be between 1 and 40", type = "warning")
      return(40)
  }
  if(input$n_players < 1){
      showNotification("The number of players must be between 1 and 40", type = "warning")
      return(1)
  }
  return(input$n_players)
})

```

```{r data-processing}
dat <- reactive({
  dat_s %>%
    filter(Position %in% input$position) %>%
    filter(Team %in% input$team) %>%
    filter(Week %in% selected_weeks()) %>% 
    group_by(Player, Team) %>% 
    mutate("Total Points" = sum(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
           "Mean Points" = mean(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
           "Total Projected Points" = sum(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
           "Mean Projected Points" = mean(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
           projected_rest_of_season = sum(ifelse(Week >= CURRENT_WEEK, Projection, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
           sd_fantasy_points = sd(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
           sd_projection = sd(Projection, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean_fantasy_points = mean(Fantasy.Points, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean_projection = mean(Projection, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(cv = sd_fantasy_points / mean_fantasy_points) %>% 
    mutate(dependability = if_else(cv>1, 0, 1-cv))
})

dat_summary <- reactive({
  dat() %>%
    select(Player, Team, Position, `Total Points`, `Mean Points`, 
           `Total Projected Points`, `Mean Projected Points`, dependability) %>% 
    unique() %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    arrange(desc(!!sym(input$point_type))) %>%
    slice(1:n_players_selected()) %>% 
    mutate(Player = reorder(Player, !!sym(input$point_type)))
})
```


Top Scorers
=====================================  

Top Scorers  {data-height=800, data-width=800}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Top Fantasy Football Players

```{r}
renderPlotly({
p <- dat_summary() %>%
    mutate(text=paste0(
        Player,"\nPosition: ", Position, "\nTeam: ", Team, 
        "\n", input$point_type, ": ", round(!!sym(input$point_type),2)
    )) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = Player, y = !!sym(input$point_type), fill=Team, text=text)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Total Points") +
    theme_light() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

ggplotly(plot_theme(p), tooltip = c("text"))
})
```

Dependability
=====================================  

Help {data-height=35, data-width=35}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
actionBttn(inputId = "help", style="gradient", icon = icon("question"))

observeEvent(input$help, {
  sendSweetAlert(session=session, title="Dependability", text="Dependability is a measure of how consistent a player is in scoring fantasy points.\nIt is calculated as 100%-sd(score)/mean(score) using the score from the chosen weeks.\n100% dependability means the player always has the same score while 50% dependability means the player's score varies by half of the mean score.", type="info")
})
```

Dependability {data-height=800, data-width=800}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Dependability of Fantasy Football Players
```{r}
renderPlotly({
    data_dependable <- dat_summary() %>% 
        mutate(text=paste0(
            Player,"\nPosition: ", Position, "\nTeam: ", Team, 
            "\n", input$point_type, ": ", round(!!sym(input$point_type),2), 
            "\nDependability: ", round(dependability, 2)*100, "%"
        ))
    
    dashed_line <- data_dependable %>% 
        summarise(dependability = 0, points = min(!!sym(input$point_type))) %>%
        ungroup() %>% 
        rbind(data_dependable %>% 
             summarise(dependability = 1, points = max(!!sym(input$point_type))) %>%
             ungroup())
  
    y_nudge <- sd(data_dependable[[input$point_type]])/10
    
    p <- ggplot() +
        geom_point(
            data = data_dependable, 
            aes(x=dependability, y=!!sym(input$point_type), color=Team, text=text),
            size=3
        ) +
        geom_line(
            data=dashed_line, 
            linetype="dashed", 
            aes(x=dependability, y=points), 
            color="#ffffff",
        ) +
        geom_text(
            data = data_dependable, 
            aes(
                x=dependability,#+0.07, 
                y=!!sym(input$point_type),#-sd(!!sym(input$point_type))/10, 
                label=Player, 
                color=Team, 
                text=text
            ), 
            nudge_y = y_nudge,
            size=3.5,
            face="bold"
        ) +
        labs(title = "",
            x = "Dependability",
            y = input$point_type) +
        theme_light() +
        scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    ggplotly(plot_theme(p), tooltip = c("text"))
})
```
